name: BoulderFinish
_intent: The awakening's finisher: from the barrage, both palms drawn back to the hips with the weight back and the chest squared, then a double palm thrust lunging 40 deg into the rock, both palms ON its face 0.3 either side of the centre line at the Hit (the boulder shatters), held, settle into TrainBoulder's first frame.
_reference: morote shotei (double palm-heel) into a boulder; Hit at frame 18 (0.6000 s)
